items.q: Looley, here, I sings, you know, but I don't sing without an instrument.

ctx.x: No, sir. Looley, here, I sings, you know, but I don't sing without an instrument. And as you know, well you do have a radio somewhere. Well, I'll get a song to sing for you. Because I used to try to sing ballads, you see. And after that I learned a different style of doing a song, which is not considered singing, called satire, you see. Like a poet would explain in a poem, you see. It was like that.
Well, what do you -- could you demonstrate what that different style of singing was for you?
